所选卡本轮放弃攻击。: The chosen card gives up its attack this round.

出战上限36张，推荐24张；起始卡组至少12张。点牌堆图标查看卡组，按费用、功能: Your active deck holds at most 36 cards; 24 is recommended and a starting deck needs at least 12. Click the deck stack to inspect or sort by cost, role, element, or name. Sorting changes the display, not draw order. The default starting deck has 16 cards. Rewards go directly into the active deck until the 36-card cap calls for management; when it is already full, new rewards enter the reserve. Reserve cards are not drawn.
双方基础起手各5张，包含1张余芯，首回合无需再抽牌。每轮回首关掷币后，金币化为1: Both sides start with 5 cards, including 1 Wick, and need not draw in round 1. After the first encounter's coin toss in each cycle, the coin becomes 1 extra Wick for the second player: 5 opening cards for the first player, 6 for the second. This bonus does not consume the deck, but must be deployed and survive until the next round before sacrifice. Main-story battles start with an empty board. Thereafter, each round grants 1 free Wick, followed by a choice: draw 1 deck card or take another Wick. Each ● in a cost requires one friendly sacrifice. Newly summoned cards cannot be sacrificed until the next round. Wick on either board is marked Fresh or Ready to Sacrifice; both sides follow the same rule.
未获得的牌以问号背面封存，不能查看能力或自由编入；获得并实际加入出战后才永久解锁: Unobtained cards remain hidden behind question-mark backs; their abilities cannot be inspected and they cannot be freely added. A card permanently unlocks once obtained and actually added to the active deck. New reserve cards must be added and saved first. Ordinary active cards allow up to 2 copies of a name; each Gilded card allows 1 copy across active deck and reserve combined. Wick is unlimited. During a 16-encounter cycle, keep at most 1 provisional Death Identity. On a second death, keep the old card or replace it. It accompanies retries, but becomes permanently archived and freely available for deckbuilding only after clearing all 16 encounters in the cycle.
正式战斗的死亡次数在当前浏览器累计保存。每第3次死亡（第3、6、9次等）单独有3: Main-story deaths accumulate in this browser. Every third death (3, 6, 9, and so on) independently has a 33% chance to generate a stronger identity than the previous death remnant. It may cost 1, 2, or 3; growth has a cap. A failed roll neither consumes nor weakens your kept identity. Only one provisional card may be kept per cycle. On another death, compare the old and new cards, then keep or replace. Clearing 16 encounters makes it permanent. Practice deaths do not count.
与守关Boss同名的普通或鎏金卡部署在我方场上后，可点击我方生命旁的技能按钮装备: Deploy an ordinary or Gilded card matching a gatekeeping Boss, then click the ability button beside your life to equip that Boss's unique active power. A card in hand or deck cannot provide it. Equip at most once per round; powers unlock in round 2. Each successful activation additionally consumes 1 unfrozen Wick from your hand. It then rests for the next round and becomes usable again the following round. Any original discard, life, or other costs are paid separately. Activate deployment powers during your deployment phase; prepare after-attack powers first, and they resolve after both sides attack. Friendly and enemy effects and costs are interpreted from your perspective. An equipped power carries over, but stops working if its source leaves play or temporarily becomes Wick. Switching cards or powers cannot bypass activation limits.
每位守关者使用与自身角色和技能搭配的专属卡组。Boss名字旁显示专属技能，点按或: Each gatekeeper uses a themed deck suited to its character and power. The Boss's ability appears beside its name; click or hover to read its timing, costs, and current status. From round 2, a successful activation consumes 1 unfrozen Wick from hand, skips the next round, and can be used again the following round. With no valid target or insufficient payment, no Wick is spent and no cooldown begins. Both sides follow this rule. Deployment powers activate during enemy deployment; after-attack powers activate after both sides finish attacking. Discarding a hand card does not trigger Deathrattle, death draws, or Rekindle. Drawing still consumes the finite deck. View both discard piles in the battle log.
暂时余芯化会覆盖玩家下一次完整行动，之后恢复原卡当前攻血与成长，不回满血、不重复: Temporary Wick form lasts through the player's next complete action. The original card then returns with its current attack, health, and growth; it is not fully healed and does not repeat deployment effects. If the Wick is killed or sacrificed, it never returns and the original card's Deathrattle does not trigger. A newly restored card is immune to another transformation for one round.
共有${POOL.filter(c=>c.rarity==='rare'&&!c: There are ${POOL.filter(c=>c.rarity==='rare'&&!c.token).length} Gilded cards, including all 96 cycle Bosses and legacy collectibles, with stronger attack and health than their ordinary versions. An ordinary clear reward has a 5% chance to include the current Boss's Gilded card among three choices; choose one. Clearing encounter 16 of a cycle guarantees a choice of three different Gilded Boss cards from that game; add one to your deck. Growth grants +1 attack whenever the card kills an enemy card with its own attack, not through direct life damage or poison. Deathrattle triggers on death and sacrifice. Gilded Wick Spiders appear first in the original lane and then nearby empty lanes; overflow enters your hand. Summoned units must survive until the next round before sacrifice. Deathrattle tokens do not count as collectible rares.
苔庭潜印客·莫恩出场后，可选一张自己的手牌冻结。冻结本回合与下一回合，期间不能打: When Patches enters play, choose one of your hand cards to freeze. It cannot be played for the current and next round. At the start of the third round, it thaws automatically and its sacrifice cost falls by 1, to a minimum of 0. The hand card shows the rounds remaining. Right-click, press Esc, or choose Skip to forgo this effect; the completed deployment is not undone. Freezing and cost reduction last only for this battle.
点选手牌，再选祭品与落点。选错时按鼠标右键或Esc，手机点击“取消”，即可清除选: Select a hand card, then its sacrifices and destination. Right-click or press Esc, or tap Cancel on mobile, to clear the selected card, sacrifices, and movement choice. Cancel clears only unconfirmed selections; completed plays and moves are not undone. With no hand card selected, click a friendly unit with Shift or Swap and use the arrow buttons to reposition it once per round. After swapping, neither unit can move again that round. Knockback does not grant another attack.
每轮回首关，先选契币正反，再点击灯契币投掷：猜中我方先手，否则Boss先手。金币: At the first encounter of each cycle, choose heads or tails, then toss the gold dragon coin. A correct guess gives you initiative; otherwise the Boss goes first. A chime and spinning sound accompany the result, then the coin becomes Wick for the second player. Opening initiative alternates between Boss encounters; within a battle, the first side to deploy and attack alternates each round. Moving from second to first can give the Boss consecutive deployments across a round boundary. A central notice and separated log entries mark the new round; freshly placed Wick still cannot be sacrificed in the same round. Attacks resolve only after both sides deploy, and each surviving card attacks at most once per round. Guard stops Flying. Lifesteal and poison require damage to take effect.
护盾完整抵消下一次受到的伤害，随后消失；没有造成伤害的攻击不消耗护盾。普通敌卡死: A shield fully blocks the next instance of damage, then disappears. Attacks that deal no damage do not consume it. Ordinary enemy cards do not automatically leave Wick in Souls encounters. Only abilities explicitly printed on the card leave remains; newly created cards must still wait until the next round before sacrifice.
首页和第一关可选择重战已经击败的单个Boss，未通关关卡锁定。重战使用最近保存的: From the home screen or first encounter, replay any single Boss you have defeated. Unbeaten encounters stay locked. Replays use your latest saved deck, do not overwrite the story save, and grant neither clear rewards nor death growth.
每个轮回按第1–4、5–8、9–12、13–15关分段切换原创配乐，第16关另用: Each cycle changes its original soundtrack for encounters 1–4, 5–8, 9–12, and 13–15, with a separate final-Boss track for encounter 16: 30 tracks in all. Toggle music independently with the top button; its description shows the current title and encounter range. Mute preferences are saved in this browser. Music pauses in the background and resumes on return. All tracks are synthesized locally, with no separate music download.
苔雾荒庭 → 铜钟堡垒 → 炽砂熔城 → 暮潮港湾 → 霜枝高地 → 星铸天穹。: Mireglass Reach → Brassbell Citadel → Cinderglass Foundry → Dusk-Tide Harbor → Frostbough March → Starforged Expanse. Each cycle has 16 different gatekeepers, for 96 encounters total. Difficulty and enemy decision-making increase with each cycle. Your earned active deck and reserve carry forward. Advancement and cross-cycle decks are stored in this browser and can be managed from the home screen. The story saves at safe deployment points and after encounters; reloading resumes unfinished play and preserves unclaimed rewards. If no one wins by round 36, life and board strength decide the outcome; an exact tie favors the player.
